title: Sum a range of numbers
description: Write a function `sum_up_to(n)` that returns the sum of every integer from 0 to `n`, inclusive.
hints: Function to consider: sum(), combined with range()
sum(range(n + 1)) adds up every value range produces in one call - a running total variable updated inside a for loop reaches the same number.
expected_behavior: Returns the sum of integers from 0 to n.
explanation: sum() is a reduction over an iterable, exactly like a loop that accumulates into a total variable - range(n + 1) supplies the same sequence of numbers a for loop would iterate over.
